mapper.insert: INSERT INTO statistics_batch_runs ( batch_type, status, source_window_started_at, source_window_ended_at, target_start_date, target_end_date ) VALUES ( #{batchType}, 'RUNNING', #{sourceWindowStartedAt}, #{sourceWindowEndedAt}, #{targetStartDate}, #{targetEndDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE statistics_batch_runs SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
UPDATE statistics_batch_runs SET heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{batchRunId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE statistics_batch_runs SET last_completed_date = #{lastCompletedDate}, heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{batchRunId} AND batch_type = 'BACKFILL' AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE statistics_batch_runs SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{batchRunId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE statistics_batch_runs SET status = 'FAILED', heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{batchRunId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT source_window_ended_at FROM statistics_batch_runs WHERE batch_type = 'DAILY' AND status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND source_window_ended_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY source_window_ended_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT started_at FROM statistics_batch_runs WHERE batch_type = 'BACKFILL' AND status = 'SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT last_completed_date FROM statistics_batch_runs WHERE batch_type = 'BACKFILL' AND last_completed_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
